about.full:
I'm **Sanjib Santra**, a **Full Stack Engineer (MERN / Next.js / TypeScript)** with hands-on production ownership across enterprise healthcare technology, headless CMS architectures, multi-tenant SaaS systems, and live client-deployed ERPs.

**Engineering Philosophy & Production Ownership**
What differentiates my engineering work is end-to-end ownership from day one. I don't just write features — I partner with stakeholders to discover domain requirements, architect scalable data models, implement hardened security boundaries, and drive systems through to production deployment and operational handover.

**Production Highlights & Track Record**
• **Help Create Families (HCF)**: Contributed to an enterprise surrogacy and parentage monorepo (Next.js 15, React 19, Express, MongoDB) featuring a 20+ block schema engine that eliminated developer dependencies for marketing page launches, alongside an ARIA-compliant 50-state legal directory and Brevo CRM sync.
• **Enterprise Multi-Role LIMS**: Architected a production-grade multi-tenant diagnostic SaaS spanning 4 specialized micro-portals (Core Lab, Franchise Collection, Patient, SaaS Admin) and a centralized Node.js/Express API. Built a high-concurrency PDFKit report pipeline bounded by `p-limit` pools, 6-tier RBAC with `superUserId` and `labId` scoping, and a self-healing WhatsApp worker achieving 98% delivery reliability.
• **Dooars Green FPO ERP**: Served as the sole full-stack developer on a live client ERP deployed for a rural agricultural producer. Translated complex agricultural accounting logic into an auditable platform consolidating 7 operational workflows, automated ₹ PDF statements via Puppeteer, and enforced user-level query isolation to prevent IDOR.
• **EasilyJob (Hiring Platform & Placement Cell)**: Architected a commercial-grade recruitment SaaS implementing the Transactional Outbox Pattern with Prisma ORM to guarantee zero dropped emails, real-time Socket.IO candidate-recruiter messaging, and double-submit CSRF protection.

**Core Technical Proficiency**
• **Frontend Architecture**: Next.js 15/14 (App Router, SSR, SSG), React 19/18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Vite, Responsive Mobile-First Design.
• **Backend & Distributed Systems**: Node.js, Express.js 5, RESTful API Design, Prisma ORM, MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose, Socket.IO, Transactional Outbox Pattern, Event-Driven Architecture.
• **Security & Infrastructure**: JWT refresh token rotation, rotating httpOnly cookies, RBAC, double-submit CSRF, Helmet, rate limiting, Puppeteer PDF generation, Docker, CI/CD, Vercel, Render.

**Academic Excellence & Credentials**
• **Master of Computer Applications (MCA)** — Future Institute of Engineering and Management, Kolkata (CGPA: 7.18/10).
• **Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)** — Prabhat Kumar College, Contai (CGPA: 9.30/10).
• **Certified Full Stack Web Developer** — Coding Ninjas (Mar – Nov 2025).
• **NPTEL Online Certification** — IIT / NPTEL (2024).
• **Claude AI 101 Certification** — Anthropic (2025).
• Team Player of the Year (2024) — Recognized Excellence.

I believe the most impactful engineers solve business-critical bottlenecks with resilient, maintainable code — always prioritizing architecture before code and security as a default.

projects.title: Help Create Families (HCF)
projects.description: Enterprise surrogacy and parentage platform built as an npm Workspaces monorepo: Next.js 15 public site, React 19/Vite admin CMS, and Express/MongoDB API sharing a common TypeScript types package.
projects.problem: Marketing and clinic intake teams relied heavily on engineering for every single landing page change, while prospective parents needed a compliant, secure 50-state screening and intake pipeline.
projects.solution: Engineered a schema-driven block engine with 20+ customizable page blocks, an ARIA-compliant 50 US-state directory with debounced search and tier filtering, and an automated screening quiz integrated with Google reCAPTCHA v3 and CRM sync.
architectureHighlights: Monorepo architecture using npm Workspaces: shared TypeScript types package across Next.js 15, Vite admin, and Express API.
Schema-driven block engine with 20+ production components (hero, timelines, comparison tables, FAQs) eliminating developer deployment dependency.
State-by-state legal eligibility directory covering all 50 US states plus DC with tier filtering and debounced search.
Secured admin with JWT refresh token rotation, idle-timeout session renewal, and role-based access control (Admin, Editor, Read-Only).
keyFeatures: Candidate screening quiz protected by Google reCAPTCHA v3 syncing directly to Brevo and medical CRMs with audit logging.
GSAP ScrollTrigger animations and fluid CSS clamp() typography for 320px to 4K responsive layouts.
Resilient CRM form-dispatch service with automated retry and webhook synchronization.
Zero-developer-dependency page composition workflow for non-technical marketing staff.
impact: Completely eliminated engineering bottlenecks for marketing and clinic page launches.
Delivered enterprise-grade HIPAA/regulatory alignment with consent-first intake routing.
Live in active production serving prospective families across the United States.

projects.title: Enterprise Multi-Role LIMS
projects.description: Enterprise multi-tenant Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) powering 4 specialized web portals with a centralized high-throughput Node.js REST API. Automates diagnostic operations from phlebotomy accessioning and real-time specimen tracking to multi-tier pathologist verification, concurrency-bounded PDF reports, and self-healing WhatsApp delivery.

projects.problem: Diagnostic laboratories faced severe bottlenecks: phlebotomy accessioning was decoupled from satellite collection centers, pathologists experienced lag during peak verification hours, high-volume PDF rendering choked server event loops, and patient WhatsApp delivery suffered frequent drop-offs.
projects.solution: Architected a distributed multi-tenant platform comprising 4 specialized micro-frontends and a centralized Node.js/Express backend with 6-tier RBAC, SSE specimen tracking, p-limit bounded PDFKit pipelines, and an exponential-backoff WhatsApp worker.
architectureHighlights: Strict multi-tenant data partitioning with superUserId and labId scoping across all database queries.
Granular 6-tier Role-Based Access Control (Lab Owners, Pathologists, Technicians, Franchise Centers, Patients, Super Admins).
High-throughput PDF report pipeline using PDFKit, bwip-js (Code128 barcodes), dynamic QR codes, and p-limit concurrency pooling.
Self-healing WhatsApp notification engine with exponential backoff retries ([15m, 1h, 4h, 12h, 24h]) and HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification.
Server-Sent Events (SSE) broadcasting real-time specimen handoffs between satellite centers and central testing laboratories.

ecosystem.name: Core Laboratory Operations Portal
ecosystem.description: Primary diagnostic workstation handling rapid accessioning, 50+ parameter result entries with biological reference highlighting, two-stage medical signoff, and 5 customizable report templates.

ecosystem.name: Franchise & Satellite Collection Portal
ecosystem.description: B2B sample collection workstation managing regional sample intake, barcode bag scanning, batch logistics dispatch, and commission ledger reconciliations.

ecosystem.name: Direct-to-Consumer Patient Portal
ecosystem.description: Mobile-responsive web app offering OTP-based authentication, catalog search, real-time sample stage tracking, and authenticated PDF report downloads.

ecosystem.name: SaaS Super Admin Governance Portal
ecosystem.description: Multi-tenant lifecycle management, license provisioning, subscription tier gating (Free, Pro, Enterprise), and platform revenue analytics.

ecosystem.name: Central LIMS Backend API & Workers
ecosystem.description: High-throughput Node.js/Express REST API powering tenant isolation, SSE real-time streams, PDFKit rendering pools, and Razorpay webhook processing.

technicalChallenges.title: Concurrency & Memory Management in PDF Generation
technicalChallenges.problem: High-volume morning report generation with high-res vector barcodes and doctor signatures caused event-loop lag and memory spikes.
technicalChallenges.solution: Implemented p-limit concurrency pools to throttle parallel rendering tasks, piped PDF streams directly to disk/SFTP, and pre-validated image buffers.
technicalChallenges.metric: Zero event loop stalls during peak hours

technicalChallenges.title: Resilient WhatsApp Delivery Engine
technicalChallenges.problem: Unreliable network connectivity and Meta Cloud API rate limits caused lost report delivery notifications to patients.
technicalChallenges.solution: Built a self-healing background worker with exponential backoff ([15m, 1h, 4h, 12h, 24h]), HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures, and 500ms pacing.

technicalChallenges.title: Strict Multi-Tenancy & Data Scoping
technicalChallenges.problem: Healthcare compliance required absolute data isolation across competing laboratories and satellite franchises.
technicalChallenges.solution: Enforced tenant isolation at the Mongoose middleware boundary and JWT claims, rejecting untrusted tenant IDs before reaching controllers.

technicalChallenges.title: Zero-Flicker Form Architecture with 50+ Parameters
technicalChallenges.problem: Controlled React form inputs lagged significantly when entering values across large diagnostic panels (e.g. 20+ parameter metabolic panels).
technicalChallenges.solution: Migrated to uncontrolled React Hook Form with Yup schema validation, eliminating unnecessary re-renders across 50+ biological metrics.

keyFeatures: Full booking & sample lifecycle: accessioning → collection → testing → verification → delivery.
Real-time specimen logistics and handoff feeds between satellite franchises and core lab using SSE.
Two-tier pathologist verification workflow embedding dynamic e-signatures and QR codes.
Razorpay split transactions (Cash / Online / Due) and automated subscription billing.
Interactive staff onboarding tours powered by React Joyride.
impact: Powering 4 web portals and 6 distinct user tiers across central laboratories and franchise collection points.
Reduced patient report delivery drop-off by 98% through automated self-healing background retry queues.
Decreased redundant client API calls by 45% via TanStack React Query v5 caching and optimistic updates.
Achieved sub-50ms query latency across high-volume booking and sample tracking records.

projects.title: Dooars Green FPO ERP
projects.category: Solo Client Deployment — Dooars Green FPO (MCS Ltd.)
projects.description: Sole developer on a live, client-deployed tea procurement and financial settlement ERP for Dooars Green FPO (MCS Ltd.) — from requirement gathering and system design through to production deployment and client handover.
projects.problem: A rural Farmer Producer Organisation ran seven fragmented operational workflows — merchant management, factory records, labour tracking, buyer management, payments, advances, and dashboard reporting — with no unified system, causing manual accounting errors, payment delays, and reconciliation overhead.
projects.solution: Gathered domain accounting rules directly from agricultural stakeholders, architected a unified React/Node.js/MongoDB platform with user-scoped multi-tenancy, automated A4 PDF invoice/statement generation with Indian Rupee (₹) formatting via Puppeteer, and hardened authentication.
architectureHighlights: User-level data isolation — every database query is scoped to the authenticated user ID, strictly preventing cross-tenant data access.
Automated PDF generation via Puppeteer with Indian currency formatting (₹) and serverless Chromium fallback for Vercel deployment.
Full auth hardening stack: JWT access tokens with rotating httpOnly refresh cookies, bcrypt password hashing, Helmet security headers, CORS allowlisting, and rate limiting.
keyFeatures: Consolidated all 7 operational workflows (merchant, factory, labour, buyer, payments, advances, dashboard) into one unified auditable platform.
Automated printable A4 settlement statements, weighbridge receipts, and invoices.
CSV bulk-import pipeline for migrating legacy agricultural records.
Glassmorphic branded portal with multi-session token security.
impact: Live in production — currently operating as the daily operational backbone for Dooars Green FPO.
Sole developer from discovery through requirement gathering, system design, implementation, deployment, and client handover.
Eliminated 7 fragmented manual workflows into a single auditable system — direct end-to-end engineering ownership.

projects.title: EasilyJob — Placement Portal
projects.description: Full-featured hiring platform and placement management cell with dual recruiter/job-seeker workspaces, multi-round interview pipelines, private candidate scoring, real-time Socket.IO chat, and the Transactional Outbox Pattern for email delivery.
projects.problem: Traditional placement and campus hiring portals suffer from dropped transactional emails during SMTP timeouts, lack real-time candidate-recruiter messaging, and offer no structured interview stage scoring.
projects.solution: Architected an end-to-end recruitment platform with segregated role workspaces (recruiter ATS vs. applicant dashboard), real-time WebSocket communications, and a resilient Transactional Outbox Pattern using Prisma ORM to ensure zero message loss.
architectureHighlights: Transactional Outbox Pattern: email records written in the same atomic Prisma transaction as business events, processed by background workers with exponential backoff.
Real-time recruiter-candidate messaging powered by Socket.IO with cookie-authenticated handshakes and HTTP POST fallbacks for serverless environments.
Security hardening: short-lived JWTs, rotating httpOnly cookies, double-submit CSRF tokens, Helmet security headers, rate limiting, and tenant query isolation preventing IDOR.
keyFeatures: Dual dedicated portals: Recruiter ATS Kanban board with inline PDF resume preview vs. 1-click candidate application tracker.
Multi-round interview evaluation matrix (technical, communication, culture-fit scoring).
Live 5-stage status stepper for real-time application progress updates.
Automated transactional notification engine with idempotency keys preventing duplicate alerts.
impact: Zero email drops achieved through Transactional Outbox background processing.
Modernized the university placement cell workflow into a production-grade commercial recruitment experience.
Live on Vercel with active open-source repository on GitHub.

projects.title: Hospital Portal SPA

projects.problem: Healthcare patients require immediate access to emergency hotlines, operating clinic hours, doctor timetables, and appointment requests without navigating convoluted multi-page menus.
projects.solution: Designed and developed an intuitive, high-performance single-page healthcare portal with prioritized emergency action triggers, real-time operating timetable widgets, doctor profile showcases, and accessible appointment forms.
architectureHighlights: Two-tier responsive navigation architecture: top emergency contact bar and sticky secondary navigation with mobile drawer.
Real-time diagnostic clinic schedule table and direct emergency hotline call dispatch (1-800-123-4560).
Modular department & medical specialist showcase with clean CSS card layouts and fluid responsive typography.
keyFeatures: Diagnostic & opening hours interactive timetable with live operating status.
Emergency case rapid-contact module with one-tap dialing.
Multi-speciality department grid (cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, diagnostic imaging).
Doctor timetable lookup and integrated appointment request booking flow.
Responsive, cross-browser tested layout optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
impact: Streamlined patient onboarding by consolidating emergency, scheduling, and doctor discovery into a fast single-page experience.
Live deployment on Vercel with public source code on GitHub demonstrating versatile frontend execution.
